$comment: VTID-05781 (plan autonomous-to-staging-r2, lane staging-cutover; design.md §9): every workflow that names the staging gateway host, classified by what an isolated staging data plane does to it. Read by scripts/ci/staging-db/impact.mjs. blocks_flip=true keeps AWS-STAGE-CUTOVER.yml closed until resolved_when holds or (acceptable=true) the owner names the file in repository variable STAGING_CUTOVER_IMPACT_ACCEPTED. A new workflow that names the host and is not listed here is unclassified, which also keeps the flip closed.

classes.governance-ledger-write: writes the one VTID ledger / plan-sparring records through the gateway; isolated, it would write a second ledger
classes.governance-signal-write: writes records that production operators read today only because staging shares the production data plane (findings, self-heal reports, requests, health tiles); isolated, they land in the synthetic staging database
classes.staging-scoped-write: writes staging-only state on purpose; isolated, the write stays on staging (today it reaches the production database)
classes.staging-read-probe: reads or probes the staging gateway; isolated, it reads synthetic data
classes.deploy-config: only names the host as a configuration value or a deploy/verification target

PLAN-SPAR.yml.evidence: PLAN-SPAR.yml:92 GATEWAY_URL defaults to the staging gateway

VTID-ALLOCATE.yml.evidence: VTID-ALLOCATE.yml:36 POST /api/v1/vtid/allocate on the staging gateway by default

DEV-AUTOPILOT.yml.evidence: POST /api/v1/dev-autopilot/scan (twice daily); the production Dev Autopilot queue stops receiving the scan

E2E-ORB-MONITOR.yml.evidence: POST /api/v1/self-healing/report (self-heal tasks); isolated, the allocator is off and no VTID is minted

SCREEN-LOAD-TIMING.yml.evidence: reports screen-load results that feed the Command Hub service-health grid

REUSABLE-NOTIFY.yml.evidence: POST /new-request-with-notification on secrets.GATEWAY_URL, staging by default

AWS-STAGE-DEPLOY-KIRO-RUNNER.yml.evidence: MCP_GATEWAY_URL: the staging Kiro runner's MCP writes go through the staging gateway

OPS-TOGGLE-FLOW-V3-STAGING.yml.evidence: POST /api/v1/governance/controls/<key> on staging (today it flips the production database row)

EXERCISE-STAGING-SHADOW-CORPUS.yml.evidence: drives the staging shadow exerciser with the golden corpus

MORNING-SYSTEM-HEALTH-CHECK.yml.evidence: GET build-info and health probes on staging; its database checks use repo secrets, not the staging gateway

AWS-STAGE-DEPLOY-GATEWAY.yml.evidence: gateway_url default, GATEWAY_URL / GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL task-definition values
